redFirst.basis: gate-only task with tests.expectRedFirst false and tests.add empty: no case of mine to prove red. The behaviour change was probed off-browser in scratch (see outcome.technical); the in-browser proof is the new held-answer leg, which the task's gate runs.

outcome.technical: tools/capture-screenshots.mjs only. Added confirmWrite(page, label, write): it arms page.waitForResponse for the write request (method + path) and a page-side MutationObserver on #toast (childList/characterData only, so the class change from the toast's own hide timer is not seen) BEFORE clicking dialog.confirm [data-cfgo]. It returns once the write has answered and the page has written its toast. Every confirmed save in the panel toasts once it has acted, and no panel toast fires on a timer (checked with grep -n 'toast(' plugins/audit/scripts/ui/panel/*.js; every hit is a user action or boot). If either wait runs out it throws, naming the save: '<label>: the confirmed PUT /api/composition got no answer within 30000 ms (...)' or '... was answered (HTTP n) and the page never acted on the answer ...'. A page with no #toast is refused before the click. The helper's comment says how to tell the two kinds of pause apart: a pause belongs to the helper when the next line reads something a request has to change; a pause after an action that sends no request (Discard, a dialog closing, a transition) stays a literal. New constants: COMPOSITION_URL, COMPOSITION_WRITE, CONFIG_WRITE, PROPOSAL_WRITE, CONFIRM_ANSWER_MS=30000, HELD_ANSWER_MS=2500. Replaced click+waitForTimeout with confirmWrite at nine sites: composition confirm (was 900), moved-manifest confirm (900), settings save (700), skills null save (900), skills clear save (900), settings restore at the end of the save-note lifecycle (400), proposals drop/revive (900 each) and materialize (1200). Proving leg: the skills clear-back save now routes **/api/composition, holds the PUT for HELD_ANSWER_MS before route.continue(), and counts the holds. The existing disk read must still see []; held !== 1 fails as a vacuous proof, and a new pass note records the hold. Under the old 900 ms wait the read runs while the file still holds null, so the existing 'did not write [] back' fail fires. That direction is reasoned here and left to the gate (no browser run, as instructed). Added one POLL_WAIT_ALLOWED row ('timeout: CONFIRM_ANSWER_MS', sites 1), because tools/ui-tests/gate-card-wait.test.mjs flags any wait of the poll interval or more. Left alone on purpose: sites 4520/4565 already wait on the PUT response plus the card paint, under the leg's own failure text; the Discards at ~3036, ~3531, ~4687 and the ADO card's two (no request; the revert and toast run inside the click's task). The moved-manifest refresh-race mechanism is unchanged, with nothing added to it. Checks run: (a) node --check tools/capture-screenshots.mjs -> exit 0. (b) Scratch probe running gate-card-wait.test.mjs's own scanner code over the edited file: 15 sites, unlisted/stale/broad all empty, exit 0. On a scratch copy with the helper's bound removed it reports my row stale+broad, exit 1. (c) Scratch fake-page probe of confirmWrite's text extracted from the file: h1 returns only after a late answer is acted on, h2 unanswered throws naming PUT /api/composition, h3 answered-but-not-acted throws, h4 no #toast refused: 4/4 passed, exit 0. A copy that returns straight after the click scored 1/4, exit 1. Git diff: only click/sleep lines and one comment removed. No fail() or note() string changed. NOT DONE, out of scope: tools/ui-checks/stage-tabs.mjs has the same shape (policy Save confirms at ~978 and ~1016, each followed by waitForTimeout(900), and a Discard at ~1035). It is not in this task's files, and the orchestrator said to hand such a file back rather than edit it. To fix it, put confirmWrite on stageCtx (main(): const stageCtx = {...}) and call it with {method:'PUT', path:'/api/config'}. The policy save toasts BEFORE it re-reads /api/policy and repaints, so the read at ~983 also needs a page predicate after the helper (e.g. waitForFunction on the row's data-verdict). Acceptance (1) therefore holds for capture-screenshots.mjs but not for the stage file it imports. Dependants: check-report-interactive.mjs and the ui-tests armed-reason, capture-provenance and gate-reasons import or read exports and text I did not change, so they still hold (capture-provenance: no new screenshot call). gate-card-wait.test.mjs gets one new allow-list row and the scanner probe (b) is green. captured-at.json is unchanged, since the proof leg sits in the writes-last block after every shot. _evidence_io.py and panel-server.py refer to the file by path only, so they still hold. tests/test__refs.py and tools/check-committed-pii.py mention the name in prose, so they still hold. Repro mode shares these legs: same helper, no mode-specific branch.
outcome.descriptive: The panel gate now reads each confirmed save's result once the save has answered and the page has handled it, not after a fixed sleep. One leg holds a save's request 2.5 s to prove it, and a save that never answers fails by name.
